data.one_liner: Provides smoother and aesthetic scrolling on the Flutter web platform.
data.what_it_does: Helps overcome jerky and laggy scrolling experiences on Flutter web by adding smooth scroll animations and controlling scroll behavior. It is designed to wrap scrollable widgets and works with a shared ScrollController.
use_when: You are developing a Flutter web application and need smoother scrolling.
You want to customize scroll speed, animation length, and curves for web users.
avoid_when: You are building for mobile or desktop platforms instead of web.
You cannot use NeverScrollableScrollPhysics on the child scrollable widget.
strengths: Improves the default jerky web scrolling experience in Flutter.
Supports customizable scroll speed, animation length, and curves.
weaknesses: Should only be used on the web platform.
data.minimal_example:
WebSmoothScroll(
  controller: _scrollController,
  child: SingleChildScrollView(
    physics: const NeverScrollableScrollPhysics(),
    controller: _scrollController,
    child: _buildScrollableList(),
  ),
)
